closed_enumeration.input: the previously accepted loaded manifest catalogue; not this evidence JSON/TSV

rules.when: each declared table, keep service/rights/fields metadata
existing list form; first segment prefix, same unbounded tail/query
existing routes form; whole-segment prefix, class metadata wait/stream/refusals/calls unchanged
each declared exact complete relative filename, including all / segments
existing route name or object; separate holder route/id raw remainder, not inferred from rows placeholder

contexts: if selected CONSOLE_ROOT=name, short root paths
explicit /<sub>/ paths, including selected root itself and other mounted loaded subsystems

id.description: `numeric` or a non-secret field of type string (N1.4)

state.description: unit state — name → schema of the row `<sub>/state/<name>/<unit>` (ADR-0091 item 3); `cursor` — the cursor of the unit

writes_via.description: the rows are written only by the named subsystems with a ticket; a session, the emergency login and other tickets — 403 writes via; a write by the right of consequences is outside the word (P/06.1 N1.1a, ADR-0119 addendum (10), (11))

routes.description: routes of the process door — the first segment of the request path, byte for byte (the door token contract; the Architect's decision of 2026-10-20); an element is a name (admission `token`: a door token) or `{name, role?, domain?, rank?}` (admission by a role certificate, class `mixed` of the role certificate contract, and/or by a domain token; ADR-0091 addendum (7), (8), (14))

then.description: a route with admission `token` — by the `name` grammar (without «/»)

role.description: roles whose presented certificate admits to the route

domain.description: kinds of domain tokens that admit to the route (P/03.4 N1.7 door_admission domain); each kind is declared in domain.tokens of a subsystem of the catalogue, otherwise `refused:catalogue` (N3; ADR-0091 addendum (14) item 1)

rank.description: route rank: the token of the door `/where` carries the route only if the person's rank on the unit is not lower (P/06.5 N3); no key — `view`; only for a route with admission `token` — without `role` and `domain` (ADR-0115 addendum (19) item 1)

then.description: the first kind: the first segments of the path

shell.description: `true` — the console serves the shell `<sub>.shell.html` of this subsystem, a mounted one (P/06.5 N1.1 `mounted`); no file next to the manifest — `manifest put` refusal (P/02.3 N4)

files.description: static files of the subsystem: paths relative to the directory of the manifest file, console address `/<sub>/<path>` (P/06.5 N2 «Static files of a subsystem»); a file not read — `manifest put` refusal (P/02.3 N4)

items.description: segments separated by `/`, each starts with a letter, a digit or `_` (hence no `..`, no absolute path and no empty segment); the extension is from a closed list, without `html`; not under `api/` — that is the route space of the mounted subsystem (ADR-0094 addendum (4) item 2, addendum (8) item 2)

closed_enumeration.guards: use existing P02 form/relations/catalogue admission; do not create aliases, admit absent names, turn a default server sub into admission, or union independent fixtures
roles_rights_source: P/06.3 N1.9 gate/need and Door route
P/06.5 N2 static files, first/second pass
closed_enumeration.B1_profile: not a finite deletion body sufficiency proof; no new B/V or load preflight invented

pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). put.name: Idempotency-Key

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: id
pathItem.description: Exactly one id; the grammar depends on unit.id (N1.3). The segment is percent-decoded after the route is chosen; not UTF-8 or not by the grammar — 400 error badkey (N2; C06-UNIT-ID-BADKEY-01, decision of the Architect 2026-10-28). A path longer than one id — 404, except the bytes door /{rows}/{id}/{blob_field} of chapter 6.1 (another method on it — 405); a wrong named id — 400.

put.name: Idempotency-Key
put.description: Optional. Without it the edit converges by cas and every repeat raises revision; with it — the repeat memory (chapter 6.1 N3 «replay memory»), its order is before If-Match.

pathItem.name: pass
pathItem.description: A segment from door.pass of the loaded manifest of the subsystem (the key door.pass — P/02.1 «Form»; does not repeat door.routes, unit.rows and where — P/02.1 N1.4, rule 81). A path longer than one segment with the same first segment is passed the same way; OpenAPI sets no template of several segments. For door.pass of the second kind the route is a path of several segments (P/02.1 N1.4), and the refusals of the console 401, 403, 404, 413, 502, 503, 504 whose status is named in refusals of the manifest go in the form ProblemRefusal (the gate and pass contract, refusals).
